desc: The Smith & Wesson Model 396 is a lightweight revolver chambered in the hard-hitting 44 Special, offering an excellent balance of power and portability. Built on the proven L-Frame with a durable scandium alloy construction, it delivers dependable performance while remaining comfortable for everyday carry or outdoor use. Its compact design, smooth double-action operation, and classic Smith & Wesson reliability make the Model 396 a versatile choice for personal defense and trail protection.
